newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Advisors buys interest in KD Managers.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Advisors buys interest in KD Managers.

text.p: Consolidated Advisers Ltd LLC said Friday it has acquired a "significant" minority interest in KD Managers LLC, the general partner of Kellner DiLeo & Co LP.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Kellner, DiLeo is a private investment partnership engaged in merger and convertible bond arbitrage.
As part of the deal, CIBC Wood Gundy is also acquiring a limited partnership interest in Kellner, DiLeo, and the principals of KD Managers are acquiring minority interest in Consolidated.

Consolidated Advisers, a company sponsored and controlled by CIBC Wood Gundy, was organized to acquire interests in managers engaged in the what it said was the non-traditional and alternative sector of the money management business.
